Omeros Announces First Commercial Sales of YARTEMLEA®
items.summary: — Initial Orders Received and Fulfilled from Multiple Transplant Centers, with YARTEMLEA Now Administered to Both Adult and Pediatric Patients with TA-TMA — Jan. 27, 2026- Omeros Corporation (NASDAQ: OMER) today announced that the first commercial shipments of YARTEMLEA ® (narsoplimab-wuug) to its distributors were completed last week, with orders from transplant centers beginning that same day. Both adult and pediatric patients with stem cell transplant-associated thrombotic microangiopathy (TA-TMA) are now receiving YARTEMLEA, including patients who have recently failed prior off-label C5-inhibitor regimens, in both hospital and outpatient settings. YARTEMLEA is the first and only approved therapy for TA-TMA, an often-fatal complication of stem cell transplantation driven by activation of the lectin pathway of complement. items.title: DODD vs Aging Waiver in Ohio: Which Program Do You Qualify For?
items.summary: Trying to get Medicaid waiver support in Ohio? The first step is figuring out which system you belong to. Ohio has two separate waiver tracks: DODD waivers for people with developmental disabilities that started before age 22, and aging waivers (like PASSPORT) for older adults or people with disabilities acquired later in life. Applying to the wrong system can cost you months of time. This guide explains the key differences, who qualifies for what, and which agency to contact first.

items.title: Benchmarking Commercial Rates Against Medicare: Why the Anchor Still Holds
items.summary: Commercial healthcare prices often appear chaotic in dollar terms, but a clearer pattern emerges when rates are benchmarked to Medicare. This post explains why Medicare remains the most reliable reference point for interpreting price transparency data, how benchmarking helps normalize variation across service lines and markets, and where differences in commercial rates reflect meaningful signals rather than noise.
